== Description ==

[[Mike Turner]] (right, tan cap with a side logo, goatee, black hoodie, yellow sleeves, playing) and [[Randy Scott]] (background mid, orange cap, black hoodie, seated) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025.
